main_text.p: & transfertur, Irrigationes germinum ejus satia. Regia תקוף מרביני Vi sulcorum germina ejus irriga: Syriac. ܟܕܢܘܣ ܝ ܕܘ ܒܝܢ Filius educationum ejus, Act. 13. 1. Græc. αὐτὸς οφ. Chald Nutritius, educator, Num. 11.12. Plur. תורביני, תורבינין, 1. Reg. 21. 8. 11. & תורבנין 2. Reg. 10.1. Fœminine pro Nutrice, Cantic. 2. 6.
תורבינא Ch. Idem, Esth. 2. 9. Fœmin. תורבנתא Nutrix, 2. Sam. 4. 4.
תרבורת Chald. Nutritio, Educatio, Genes. 21. 12. in Targ. Jonath.

רביתא, רבית Chald. Fœnus, usura. Plural. רבין Usuræ, Exod. 22. 24. in Jonath. ubi in Targ. Hierosol. est ex forma singulari רביא. Sic etiam legendum Levitic. 25. 37. & 36. pro רפין. Syriac. ܪܒܝܢܐ, Matth. 25. 27. Lucæ 19. 23.
ܪܒܝܢܐ Syr. Incrementum, Augmentum, ad Eph. 4. 16. ad Philip. 1. 25. ad Coloss. 2. 19.
מורביואתא Ch. Vide supra in מך.

רבב Hebr. Multum, Copiosum esse, Multiplicari. Hinc Chal. Ithpahel geminata prima radicali, אתרבב & אתרבב; Absque ו אתרב Jesa. 27. 1. & 37. 23. Jerem. 48. 42. Syriac. ܪܒܝܢ Magnificari, Magnificare, Efferre, Evehere, Extollere se: Principatum tenuit vel gesit, de principatu contendit, Hos. 12. 3. 4.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed approximately from the scan; vocalisation and Syriac pointing are uncertain and marked where doubtful. The Syriac and Hebrew in the lower lines are only partly legible.
